description: This is an ASP.NET WebForm code-behind file for the TheoryExam page, handling the display of theory questions, timing, and submission of answers in an online examination system.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET page TheoryExam.aspx, managing question display, session validation, timer, and answer submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initial setup on page load: validating session, retrieving questions from database, and initializing timer.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the course name based on course ID.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles submission of answers, storing answers into database, queue updates, and marking course as taken.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user and navigates to LoginPage.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates countdown timer and indicates time out.
